author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
China’s AutoFlight V5000 completed its first test flight, marking a breakthrough in electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) technology. This 5-ton hybrid aircraft offers an extended range of up to 1,500 kilometers, combining electric and gas turbine propulsion for regional air mobility.

Source Article: https://www.livescience.com/technology/electric-vehicles/giant-10-person-flying-taxi-passes-first-flight-test-in-china
